content_sections.heading: NFSU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the NFSU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download NFSU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 4 vacancies are available - 1 for Research Assistant and 3 for Field Investigator.

content_sections.heading: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Postgraduate in any Social Science discipline or a relevant field (Minimum 55%) Field Investigator: Postgraduate in any Social Science discipline or a relevant field (Minimum 55%)

content_sections.heading: NFSU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Research Assistant: Not exceeding 40 years Field Investigator: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NFSU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NFSU Research Staff posts?
faq.answer: The recruitment is through a Walk-in Interview, so there is no last date for application submission. Candidates need to attend the interview on the specified date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Postgraduate degree in any Social Science discipline or a relevant field with a minimum of 55% marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The age limit for the Research Assistant post is not exceeding 40 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Field Investigator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Field Investigator position will receive a monthly stipend of Rs. 20,000/-.

faq.question: Q5. Where will the Walk-in Interview for NFSU recruitment be held?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview will be conducted at National Forensic Sciences University, Delhi Campus, Rohini, Sector -3, Outer Ring Road, Delhi-110085.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should candidates carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for these posts?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for any category.

faq.question: Q8. How many vacancies are available for Research Staff at NFSU?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Research Staff posts, including 1 Research Assistant and 3 Field Investigators.

faq.question: Q9. What is the duration of the project for which these positions are being recruited?
faq.answer: The duration for the Research Assistant post is 11 months, and for the Field Investigator post, it is 4 months.

faq.question: Q10. What is the reporting time for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should report at the venue at 11:00 hours on 24-08-2026.
